architecture.bots: deterministic queue, dedup, checkpoint, proof, retry, handoff and completion controls
architecture.scheduler: dependency-aware DAG waves with global parallel limits, in-flight effect accounting and per-agent max_parallel capacity
architecture.effect_lanes: maximum one effectful lane by default; running effect lanes consume the ceiling
architecture.completion: every required task must have terminal SUCCESS; FAILURE/CONSTRAINT cannot be relabeled complete
architecture.receipt_privacy: raw executor payloads remain process-local; durable receipts store proof references plus payload-key metadata only

integrations.omega_one: load balancing, DAG allocation, failure isolation and champion/challenger telemetry
integrations.realityguard: mandatory preflight guard for future write-capable routes; optional for internal/read-only routes
integrations.jarvis: mandatory independent semantic verification for future write-capable routes; verifier hook available for all tasks
integrations.bubbles_omega2: existing capability discovery, squad formation, proof graph and anti-proliferation controls

truth_boundary: This contract governs provider-neutral source/runtime orchestration. It does not prove native ChatGPT background workers, provider deployment, provider credentials, durable provider-write idempotency, external authority or completed external effects.
